scripts.db:migrate: cd backend && npx prisma migrate dev --name init
scripts.dev: npm run infra:up && sleep 2 && concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.setup: npm run infra:up && sleep 3 && npm run db:generate && npm run db:migrate
scripts.start: npm run setup && npm run dev
